capture.final_message:
Split the conjunction.

- For the polynomial identity, use the exponential representation of the integer-indexed Chebyshev polynomial \(S_n\):
  \[
  S_n(z+z^{-1})(z-z^{-1})=z^{n+1}-z^{-(n+1)}.
  \]
  Specialize \(z=e^\theta\). Then \(z+z^{-1}=2\cosh\theta\) and \(z-z^{-1}=2\sinh\theta\), yielding
  \[
  S_n(2\cosh\theta)\sinh\theta=\sinh((n+1)\theta).
  \]
  This representation is preferable to division by \(\sinh\theta\), since it also covers its zeros and negative integer indices uniformly.

- For the arithmetic bound, expand the difference as the contribution of higher prime powers:
  \[
  \psi(x)-\theta(x)=\sum_{k\ge2}\theta(x^{1/k})
  \]
  with only finitely many nonzero terms. The \(k=2\) term is \(O(\sqrt x)\). Bound the remaining \(k\ge3\) terms by \(O(x^{1/3}\log x)\), hence also by \(O(\sqrt x)\) after enlarging the constant. Absorb the bounded small-\(x\) range into the same constant; for negative \(x\), the Chebyshev functions vanish under their real-valued convention.

Finally combine the two independently established statements with `And.intro`.
